blind_spots.blind_spot: Hands-free eye-tracking for maintenance checklists assumes clean, consistent visual conditions
blind_spots.operator_reality: A technician in gloves, PPE, and variable hangar/field lighting (glare, low light, NVGs) will break eye-tracking calibration that looked flawless in a lab demo
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: product description never mentions field/lighting/PPE variability, only 'speed of thought interactions'
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Real Hands-free eye control of content, checklists and media for maintenance, Command and control (C2)

blind_spots.blind_spot: No mention of the headset/device's power, weight, or ruggedization
blind_spots.operator_reality: Mixed-reality hardware carried by a maintainer or C2 operator needs battery logistics and ruggedization; a device optimized for 'seamless navigation' across 'Desktop | Mobile | Embedded | Gaming | AR/VR/XR' reads as consumer-grade, not field-hardened
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: site markets breadth of platform support (retail, automotive, gaming) with no SWaP-C or field-durability language anywhere
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Works across touchscreens, VR, AR, IoT, and traditional displays

blind_spots.blind_spot: 'Currently used across multiple squadrons and wings' is stated with no advocacy chain, ATO, or sustainment detail
blind_spots.operator_reality: Squadron-level pilot use does not equal program-of-record adoption; without a champion above the operator level and an RMF/ATO path, Phase II funding lapsing kills the transition regardless of how well airmen liked the demo
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: abstract highlights ease-of-authoring by SMEs but never addresses who owns re-certification, retraining, or funding after Phase II
blind_spots.evidence_quote: allows the SME to create immersive, interactive lessons in minutes using their own content

opener_hook: Your Air Force Phase II SBIR ($1.15M, 2023) funded XR-Assist's hands-free eye control for maintenance checklists — what's the plan for calibration drift once techs are in gloves and hangar glare?
what_they_do: Predictive, gesture/eye-tracking human-machine-interface technology licensed across commercial AR/VR/IoT markets, with an Air Force SBIR-funded variant (XR-Assist) for hands-free maintenance and C2 checklists.
